title: 27 Mac apps for $29.99, all with lifetime licenses
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: This bundle gets you 27 Mac apps with lifetime licenses for $29.99 (reg. $390).

Mac utilities tend to arrive one subscription at a time, a few dollars a month each, until a menu bar full of small tools costs more than the apps you actually use. The 27-App Lifetime Mac Bundle bundles the full enSili catalog of native macOS utilities into one purchase, and lifetime licenses for all 27 are on sale for $29.99 (reg. $390).

Designers get Specimen for font management and Color Hound for pulling palettes out of any image. Developers get JSON Wizard, Regex Wizard, CodeCounter, and DMG Wizard for disk images. Everyday upkeep runs through tools like MemoryBooster for freeing inactive memory, Tidier for sorting files automatically, AllClips for clipboard history, and RenameMe for batch renaming with live previews. For media work, use ToAnything for bulk conversion, PhotoFoundry for batch processing, and Watermarker+ for adding watermarks.

Every app runs natively on macOS 10.12 or later, built by independent developer Yanis Zafiropulos, who has been making Mac software since 2010. Each license allows 2 activations, so a desktop and a laptop both stay covered, and free updates continue through each app’s next major version. Pay once for a toolkit that you can use forever.
